subject: RE:[CASE 179022088800001] SES: Production Access
body:
Hello,

Thank you for the additional information you shared regarding your Amazon SES account in the EU (Frankfurt) region.

We understand how important reliable email delivery is for your business, and we want to be transparent with you. After a thorough review of the information you provided, we are still unable to approve a sending limit increase at this time.

Our concern centers on protecting two things that matter most to your success: your sender reputation and the deliverability of your emails. Approving this request under current conditions could place your account at risk and impact the quality of delivery your recipients experience — outcomes we want to help you avoid.

For additional guidance, please review our AWS Acceptable Use Policy (https://aws.amazon.com/aup/), AWS Service Terms (https://aws.amazon.com/serviceterms/) and Amazon SES Best Practices (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/best-practices.html).

Taking proactive steps to align with these guidelines will directly strengthen your account's standing and support a successful re-evaluation.

We appreciate your understanding in this matter.

We value your feedback. Please share your experience by rating this and other correspondences in the AWS Support Center. You can rate a correspondence by selecting the stars in the top right corner of the correspondence.

Best regards,
CS Digital Messaging
